description: A U_PDU that asked for client delivery confirmation is confirmed to its client only when both the CAS confirm and the peer's DATA DELIVERY CONFIRM S_PDU have arrived.
note: Link setup and data path as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip: conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ with client delivery confirmation (Service Type 0x18: Transmission Mode ARQ, Delivery Confirmation 2), its S_UNIDATA_REQUEST of 'ping' to SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 at 0 is held for a soft link while the CAS calls, and at 91000 the peer's PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED makes the link and the U_PDU goes down to the CAS (A-0194, A-0217 to A-0220); at 108000 it goes on air in one DATA-ONLY, and at 118350 dts.ack_wait/0.0.1.3 starts. The DATA S_PDU therefore has CLIENT DELIVERY CONFIRM REQUIRED set (A-0153): byte 2 is 0xC0. On acceptance the U_PDU asked for confirmation and is held for a soft link, so its wait runs to its TTD, 0 + 648000 x 2000 ms (interp A-0232, A-0342): sis.confirm_wait starts with 1296000000 ms, the only entry in the deadline list. sis.confirm_wait_ms is unset, so the deadline stays at the TTD when the U_PDU is handed down (interp A-0342). At 126000 one burst from the peer brings an ACK-ONLY (EOT 20) acknowledging FSN 0, then a DATA-ONLY (type 9, FSN 0, EOT 20) carrying a DATA C_PDU whose S_PDU is DATA DELIVERY CONFIRM: TYPE 1, priority 0, source SAP 5, destination SAP 9 as in our DATA S_PDU, and the copy 'ping'. The acknowledgement makes the DTS confirm the C_PDU and the CAS pass C_UNIDATA_REQUEST_CONFIRM up: with client confirmation that alone gives the client nothing (A-0227), but the request is no longer outstanding on the soft link, so sis.soft_link_idle starts. The DATA DELIVERY CONFIRM, received by ARQ, restarts sis.soft_link_idle (interp A-0320) and answers that U_PDU: from 0.0.1.3, the same SAP IDs, and a copy that is the start of its U_PDU (interp A-0343). Both answers are in, so the client gets S_UNIDATA_REQUEST_CONFIRM with SAP 9, address 0.0.1.3 and 'ping' (A-0176, A-0227), and sis.confirm_wait is cancelled. The burst ends at 127000 with an acknowledgement owed to the peer: csma.vdcd_end. Fixture, addresses and draws as dts-arq/data-ack-roundtrip: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block; seed 0 draws 15, 4: contention waits 45000 and 12000 ms (K-0080). Since corpus 0.28.0 (P7-3), every D_PDU this node sends to a peer recorded Ed4 carries EOW 0xF01, CAPABILITY (Ed4 1, Duplex 0), where it carried EMPTY (C-0426, C-1260); an owed UNRECOGNIZED-TYPE-ERROR still goes first (C-1079), and D_PDUs to a peer of unknown edition, a peer recorded Ed3 or a group carry EMPTY as before. Where this note says EOW 0 or EMPTY for such a D_PDU, read CAPABILITY. Only EOW and header CRC bytes changed.
